title: Market landing design pass: featured makers, category chips, sort, and a seller prompt in the Frequency kit
detail:
The Frequency Market body (components/frequency/members/marketplace) gets a Featured makers strip (Founding, Verified or rated 4.5+, up to four, removed from their group rail), category chips from the listing categories, Top picks / Newest / Price sorts alongside Near me, a clear-filters reset, and a seller prompt panel at the end (List a product, or Sign in). The shared index header lands separately in LIVE-1012 and the pinned nav in LIVE-1027.

Featured strip, category chips and sort shipped

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/marketplace/marketplace-body.tsx','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/marketplace/item-grid.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!a.includes('Featured makers'))bad.push('no featured strip');if(!b.includes('aria-label=\x22Sort\x22'))bad.push('no sort control');if(!b.includes('aria-label=\x22Category\x22'))bad.push('no category chips');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1026: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
